Jagged frontier.d: The uneven edge of what AI can do: it may handle one task brilliantly and fail at a similar-looking one. The term comes from a 2023 Harvard Business School field experiment with BCG consultants.

Distribution shift.d: When the data a model or test meets in real use differs from the data it was trained or measured on, so earlier scores stop predicting real performance.

Rule of three.d: A statistics rule of thumb: if you see zero failures in n independent trials, the true failure rate is probably (95% confidence) below about 3/n.
